thesis: The episode explores the intersection of academic finance and practical investing, highlighting how the host's guest, André Perold, applies his thirty years of teaching experience at Harvard Business School to his role as chief investment officer at High Vista Strategies. The discussion emphasizes that investing is fundamentally a game of probability and statistics, driven by a deep interest in understanding how the world works, while also noting that Perold uses teaching as a method to learn and clarify complex financial concepts.
